decisions.quote: Discussion Summary of Replication Attempt This replication study attempted to replicate findings by Gong et al. (2017) that in a hypothetical donation task to relatives and non-relatives of varied degrees of closensess, older adults are overall less generous than young adults, but that when donating time to relatives this pattern is reversed. I did not find any evidence in support of either effect in this study. I employed two different analysis techniques: Mixed-design ANOVA (as used in the original study) and a mixed-effects linear regression which is more robust to missing data, yet neither revealed the anticipated effects. In addition, I was interested in attempting to replicate results regarding social discount rates- that older adults discount monetary donations more than young adults. Again, I did not find support for differences between age groups in social discounting rates. I am therefore inclined to deem this replication attempt a failure.
decisions.location: PRIMARY PROJECT REPORT: gong2019.html, Discussion / Summary of Replication Attempt (line 552)
decisions.reason: Although the shipped outcome_quote was a synthetic summary string rather than a verbatim quote, both the primary replication report gong2019.html (line 552) and raw_data.csv (line 219, F(1,70)=.06 vs. original F(1,134)=4.03, instructor and report replication codes = 0) confirm that the replication of Gong, Zhang, & Fung (2017/2019) Study 1 failed. Both shipped and blind codings agree on 'failed'.

decisions.quote: Discussion Summary of Replication Attempt My replication attempt of the Curse of Knowledge in Reasoning About False Beliefs originally conducted by Susan Birch and Paul Bloom failed to replicate (Birch & Bloom, 2007). The main finding reported by the authors was that participants in the ignorance condition reported lower probabilities that Vicki would first look in the red container compared to participants in the knowledge-plausible condition. In my replication, there was no statistically significant difference between the ignorance (M = 30.74, SD = 29.35) and the knowledge-plausible (M = 34.83, SD = 24.33) conditions in their reported probability regarding the red container, t = -0.65, df = 70.25, p = .518.

The prior adjudication attempt failed validation on this item because it quoted the shipped outcome_quote from an external rescue report not present in 2736b815e9f115a4.txt. In the primary source archive, both replication projects targeting Birch & Bloom (2007) Study 1—birch2007_1 (raw_data.csv line 189, t(149.58) = -1.20, adjudicated_replication_code = 0) and birch2007_2 (raw_data.csv line 271, t(70.25) = -0.65, score = 0; birch2007_2.html line 419)—failed to replicate the original study, confirming the outcome 'failed'.
